audit.why: Mirror (karma__sett.json) settled this lane as EVEN, diffRating 5/10 from Karma's side with Sett carry threat 6/10. Sett's page reads FAV 7/10 with a 52.26% win rate over 3643 games, which is a mild favour rather than a hard counter; the difference is presentation, not a contradiction of who wins each stage, so the prose stays and only the chart is corrected.
audit.corrected: Lane is a mild Sett favour: Karma owns level 1 with Inner Flame at 950 range plus Mantra, Sett owns 3 through first item, late flattens to a skill read.

audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers had the chart as Skill/Skill/Skill/Karma/Skill/Karma/Karma, which contradicts the packet levelChart AND the already-audited mirror (Karma/Skill/Sett/Sett/Skill/Sett/Skill). The content whys already say Karma's chart in plain words ('Level 1 is Karma's', 'Sett takes L3', 'Sett stays ahead L4-5', 'Sett's first item gives the grit...'), so the tokens were simply wrong.
audit.why: Packet levelChart and the opponent's audit agree; the whys already state the same answer. Layers were consistent with each other but wrong, so both must flip together.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Karma / Skill / Sett / Sett / Skill / Sett / Skill in both layers, ratings re-scaled to match, and the two full-layer whys that contradicted the new sides rewritten.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns gave no number for Focused Resolve and no way to break it; the true-damage centre of Haymaker versus Karma's Inspire shield was never tied together.
audit.why: Focused Resolve is a flat 12s at every rank with 675 cast range — the only flat-cooldown tool in her kit, so it is the cleanest thing to count. It is a tether: leaving range breaks it before the second hit roots. Haymaker deals true damage in the centre, which Karma's shield still absorbs (shields absorb true damage; only resistances are bypassed).
audit.corrected: Focused Resolve (W): flat 12s all ranks, 675 range, tether breaks on distance. Facebreaker (E) 16s at rank 1 only stuns with enemies on opposite sides — otherwise it is a slow. Haymaker's true-damage centre ignores MR but not her Inspire shield.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal note despite Mantra-empowered Focused Resolve healing Karma during the tether.
audit.why: missingInteractions flagged needs-antiheal for this matchup; Mantra Bonus on W explicitly heals her, which decides extended trades where Sett wants a long grit-banking fight.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds before extended trades — Mantra-W heals her through your chip.

edits.before: Double-punch passive makes you the strongest level-1 auto-trader in the lane. Punish Karma on every CS, but respect her opening tool — chips now, all-ins later.
edits.after: Inner Flame reaches 950 and Mantra is up at level 1 with no point spent, so the first level is Karma's. Soak the wave, eat the poke, and wait for Facebreaker at three.

edits.before: Q ranks make your punch trades heavier, but Karma has her core tools too. Keep the grit bar honest: trade in, W-shield her return damage, out.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are yours — force Mantra out defensively, then commit. Bank grit, E-stun her into your wave, and cash Haymaker's true-damage centre on the way out.

edits.before: - Karma Focused Resolve: matchup-defining — Her root tether — breaks if you LoS / outrange it. Track it before every engage.
edits.after: - Focused Resolve (W): flat 12s at every rank, 675 range. It is a tether — walk out of range and the root never lands. Engage on that 12s.

edits.before: Trade strictly around Focused Resolve: when it is down, run your full pattern; when it is up, give nothing. If ahead, freeze and starve her.
edits.after: Trade around Focused Resolve's flat 12s: down, run the pattern; up, give nothing. Mantra-W heals her, so bring Grievous Wounds to long trades.

notes: Facebreaker (E) only stuns when enemies are on OPPOSITE sides of Sett — against a solo Karma with no minions between you it is a slow, not a stun. That fact is absent from every field on this page and is the single most useful positioning cue in the lane; it did not fit the length band anywhere without cutting something better. Sett's W range reads 25000 in the kit file (tooltip artefact), not a real cast range.
